nodes.body:
Greptile Summary

This PR fixes a bug where sending an MP4 video via the Feishu channel would display as a text link (`📎 /path/to/video.mp4`) instead of an inline playable video. The root cause was that `sendMediaFeishu` used `msg_type: "file"` for all non-audio uploads, but the Feishu API requires `msg_type: "media"` to render videos inline. The fix is minimal and targeted: - Extends the `msgType` union type in `sendFileFeishu` to include `"media"` (line 332). - Updates the `msgType` selection logic in `sendMediaFeishu` from a two-way (`opus` → `"audio"`, else → `"file"`) to a three-way branch (`opus` → `"audio"`, `mp4` → `"media"`, else → `"file"`) (line 471). - Updates the three affected test expectations accordingly (lines 116–135, 179–196, 198–217). Key observations: - `sendFileFeishu` is the only call site — no other callers are impacted. - The `content` payload (`{ file_key: fileKey }`) remains valid for `msg_type: "media"`; Feishu's API treats `image_key` (cover image) as optional for that message type. - Note that `detectFileType` maps `.mov` and `.avi` to the internal type `"mp4"`, so those extensions will also be sent with `msg_type: "media"` after this change. Tests only cover `.mp4` filenames directly, but `detectFileType` itself is responsible for that mapping and is covered elsewhere.

Confidence Score: 5/5

- This PR is safe to merge — the change is minimal, well-tested, and correctly maps Feishu's API semantics for video messages. - The fix is a single-line ternary change with a corresponding TypeScript type update and properly updated tests. `sendFileFeishu` has only one call site, so there is no risk of regressions elsewhere. The `content` payload (`{ file_key: fileKey }`) is valid for all three `msg_type` values (`file`, `audio`, `media`). No new logic paths are introduced. - No files require special attention Last reviewed commit: 7a46280
